description: Creates a link to the jwatte.com contact form with the subject and message filled in, for a tool request, a correction, a question or something else, optionally naming the jwatte.com page or tool it is about. The link only opens the form: the person adds their own name and email, reviews the text and presses Send. This tool sends nothing and stores nothing.

examples.message: A checker for RSS feed validity would help.

message.description: Optional: the message text to fill in, at most 1,000 characters. No passwords or private details.

page.description: Optional: the https://jwatte.com/ page or the tool slug the request is about.

reason.description: tool_request (a tool the site should add), correction (something on the site is wrong), question, or other.

name: get_request_link
